description:
North star: compile work proportional to input; things nothing uses create no work or artifacts.

Fact (HEAD 5ea6a5830): an extern no caller reaches runs 4 jobs (ExpandFunctionSource, DefineFunction, DeriveStaticCallees, DeriveInputDemand). `def main(), do: 1 + 2` touches fz_op_add_if/ff through the unselected clauses of Kernel.+/2 (lib/kernel.fz:291-293); 00420 has 19 such externs. Cause: StaticCallees, CallGraphComponent/Recursive and InputDemand are whole-function summaries built from every clause before any activation exists.

Design (approved proposal ../fz-xxd.10.html, artifact MCMss4qzGKDSW4tKXf8xbL, revision 2):
1. StaticCallees(f) becomes ClauseCalls(f): per clause, its calls, each with a static row (Const -> the literal's type; own param -> its pattern refinement from calculate_dispatch_reachability(plan, any-row).outcome_inputs; else any). Gates LoweredBody(f), EntryDispatch(f).
2. Reaches and InputDemand are keyed by a ClauseScope (function + clause set = reach(EntryDispatch(f), row)). Only analysed rows ask (call-site keying, SeedRoot/root backend, callable target, normalize_contributions, transport via the executable's entry_reachability). Reaches(f, C) = functions the scope walk visits; Recursive(f, C) is f in Reaches(f, C), not a fact. CallGraphComponent is deleted.
3. Walks step by scope: a call from a clause to g with static row R visits (g, reach(g, R)) through ClauseCalls(g).
4. ForwardingWalk walks callee scopes inline (body facts only); the concluded-leaf read and partner case go.
5. Assertion: reach(f, widened key) == reach(f, row).
6. Transport: a return edge owner -> callee is on a cycle when owner is in Reaches(callee's scope); cut when callee id <= owner id. The grounded closure edge asks the same question (statically_reaches and settled_component go). Why components failed: 00568 List.reduce_step analysed scope {0} is never re-entered by the static walk (which enters {0,1,2}), so it formed its own component, Recursive came out false, and transport kept both edges of the reduce_cont/reduce_step cycle and deadlocked.

Predicted traces (tests pin them): `1 + 2` 144 -> 134 jobs, no job names fz_op_add_if/ff; count (xxd10/count_recursive.fz) 163 -> 152, fz_op_sub_fi keeps exactly 3 jobs; walk_typed 42 -> 42, walk not in Reaches(walk,{0}); 00568: reduce_step in Reaches(reduce_step,{0}), transport cuts exactly the reduce_step -> reduce_cont return edge.

Done when: `1 + 2` runs no job for an unreached function; every function that still gets a job is named by a static row (census shows which); every pin that rises comes from a distinct analysed scope and is approved.
title: Nothing unused creates work: a static edge exists only from a clause dispatch can select
